PROP-current-fina-post-007.text: First deposit of a CoinType into an obligation must initialize a collateral tracking entry.
PROP-current-fina-post-007.assertion: forall first_deposit(obligation, cointype): EXISTS obligation.collateral[cointype] AFTER deposit
